description.en: The ID of the channel to join.

description.zh:
幂等参数。
> 用于区分多次请求是不是同一个请求的标识，针对本接口不建议填写。
description.en: An idempotency token used to prevent duplicate requests. It is not recommended to use this parameter for this API.

description.zh:
在频道中显示的用户名称。
> 支持填写中文等字符，为避免名称过长，大小建议小于32个byte。
description.en:
The display name of the user in the channel.

> Supports characters such as Chinese. It is recommended to keep the name under 32 bytes in size.

description.zh:
推流有效时长，单位：秒，默认为43200秒。
> 若超过设置的有效期，则正在使用由本接口所生成地址进行的推流不受影响，但是用该地址重新推流则会失败。
description.en:
The validity period of the ingest URL. Unit: seconds. The default value is 43200.

> If an active stream exceeds this duration, it will not be affected. However, attempting to start a *new* stream with the expired URL will fail.

description.zh: 用户ID，不能与频道中的其他用户 ID 重复。
description.en: The user ID. The user ID must be unique among all users in the channel.

descriptions.zh:
## 使用说明
1.  通过调用CreateRTCWhipStreamAddress接口，创建在对应RTC房间（频道）的WhipAddress推流地址。
2. 使用OBS工具，通过whip协议进行推流。
    - 运行OBS推流工具。
    - 在菜单栏中选择**文件>设置**。
    - 在设置页面选择**直播**，配置如下信息，单击**确定**。

        | 参数 | 描述 | 
        | ------ | ------| 
        | 服务| 选择**WHIP**。| 
        | 服务器 | 使用步骤1中通过接口生成的WhipAddress地址。| 
        | Bearer Token| 串流密钥为空。 | 

        ![](https://img.alicdn.com/imgextra/i3/O1CN01xaAEK61umh8yP8NFe_!!6000000006080-2-tps-1746-685.png)

3. 其他用户，进入相应房间（频道）观看。

## QPS限制
本接口的单用户 QPS 限制为 40 次/秒。超过限制，API 调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
## Use with OBS Studio

1. Call the CreateRTCWhipStreamAddress API to generate a WHIP ingest URL (WhipAddress) for an ARTC channel.

2. Use OBS Studio to ingest streams over the WHIP protocol.

   - Launch OBS Studio.

   - IFrom the menu bar, select **File** > **Settings**.

   - On the Settings page, select **Stream**, configure the following information, and then click **OK**.

     | Parameter    | Description                                          |
     | ------------ | ---------------------------------------------------- |
     | Service      | Select **WHIP**.                                     |
     | Server       | Use the `WhipAddress` URL generated by the API call. |
     | Bearer Token | Leave this field empty.                              |

     ![](https://img.alicdn.com/imgextra/i3/O1CN01xaAEK61umh8yP8NFe_!!6000000006080-2-tps-1746-685.png)

3. Once you start streaming from OBS, other users can join the same ARTC channel to watch the stream.

## QPS limit

You can call this operation up to 40 times per second per account. Requests that exceed this limit are dropped and you may experience service interruptions.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun live create-rtc-whip-stream-address --client-token 58E73333-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx --app-id 6a0006dcc-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-e00e3exxxxxx --channel-id ch000000000001 --user-id zb000000000001 --display-name John --expire-time 43200 --region cn-hangzhou
